name: Leftist Heap
description: A heap-ordered binary tree that satisfies the leftist property: the rank (length of the rightmost path to a null node) of the left child is always greater than or equal to the rank of the right child. This ensures the right spine is always the shortest path, making merge operations efficient by always working along the right spine. All operations are built on merge: insert merges a single-node tree, and extractMin removes the root and merges the left and right subtrees.

pseudocode.text: if h1 = null then return h2
if h2 = null then return h1
if h1.key > h2.key then swap h1, h2
if heap = null then return null
